Title: Toxicity at clinical trial stage
Description: Separates drugs that reached FDA approval from those eliminated during clinical trials because of toxicity, using ClinTox, a MoleculeNet set of 1,478 compounds. The two outcomes are returned as independent probabilities rather than as a single verdict. A graph transformer pretrained on 10 million unlabelled molecules was fine-tuned on the pairing, with three fine-tuned folds averaged. The failed drugs are few and their failures span many mechanisms, so a high toxicity score signals resemblance to known failures rather than a specific liability.
Interpretation: Probability of FDA approval and probability of clinical trial failure through toxicity.
